verdict.rationale: The official README states 'No API key management - just sign in with your Google account' (gh-13). It also sets paid tiers apart for users who need specific model control (gh-24), which implies a free sign-in tier. A community user independently confirms a 'generous daily free quota' (comm-12), and another reports that Workspace accounts are rejected at login (comm-5). That rejection fits the story's personal-account scope rather than contradicting it. Missing for 10: documented free-tier quota limits and first-party detail on the sign-in flow; clarity on which account types are eligible beyond personal Google accounts.
